identity.name: Komodo Chinese Restaurant (printed menu: Komodo Restaurant, Chinese Food Restaurant)

sources.name: Google Maps
sources.role: Name, address with postal code R2J 4M6, phone, coordinates, hours used on the site. 4.5 stars from 244 reviews; no website listed.
sources.findings: Hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 12:00-21:00; Sat-Sun 14:00-21:00; Tuesday closed. Gallery (limited view, 10 photos) has only customer photos without dish captions: storefront (Dec 2025, sign reads Dine-in / Take out / Delivery), interior with a buffet counter, take-out boxes. A 2024 review says take out only.
sources.limitations: Limited (signed-out) view: no owner/menu photo filters, only the first 10 of 45 photos. Customer photos are not reusable without permission and were not used.

sources.name: MainMenus menu scan
sources.role: Menu and prices: printed take-out menu, uploaded July 2022 (folder date in the URL). 124 entries in 15 sections plus family dinners.
sources.findings: Menu header: Tuesday closed; Mon, Wed, Thu 11am-9pm; Fri 11am-10pm; Sat 4pm-10pm; Sun & holidays 4pm-9pm. Lunch buffet Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 11:00-2:00. 10% off pick-up orders over $35 (cash only), free delivery over $35 within 5 km. 'Behind Circle K in Windsor Park Plaza'. Prices before GST & PST. Prices subject to change.
sources.limitations: The MainMenus page text itself is generic filler; only the scan is used. Scan is at least three years old.

sources.name: Food Winnipeg blog (Ray Yuen), 11 Aug 2021
sources.role: Identity check (address and phone). Mentions Deluxe Fried Rice, Chow Mein, Sesame Seed Breaded Chicken and Soo Guy Chicken, all on the scanned menu.
sources.limitations: Blog photos are the author's own and were not used.

sources.name: PagesJaunes / Yellow Pages
sources.role: Discrepancy only: lists unit 7-1031 Autumnwood Dr and postal code R2J 1C6.
